result.final: The lowest price anyone charges for size XS of the Quenby tee, among listings that can actually be bought, is $11.35 at Ashgrove Clothing Co (http://localhost:7770/igr-rp28-28.html). I verified availability by opening the listing, choosing XS in the size menu (it was selectable, not disabled/greyed out), and reading the page price of $11.35 shown with XS selected, with Add to Cart enabled. I checked availability rather than relying on the size being merely listed. Listings opened: 4 (Ashgrove $10.20, Pembroke $10.72, Fairhaven $11.13, Fordwich $11.23); skipped: 41 (all unopened listings with advertised price >= $11.35, i.e. Garrick $11.96 through Foxcombe $37.82); rejected for unavailable: 1 (Fairhaven Outfitters - XS option disabled). Other available XS prices read: Pembroke Threads $12.58, Fordwich Garments $12.70 (its 'Promo $9.98' label text was not the actual price).
